name: teltonika_ftc921
description: AVL parameters that Traccar's Teltonika decoder leaves as raw io<id> values, taken from the Teltonika Telematics wiki page for the FTC921. Note that Traccar decodes several IDs only when the device's model field is set to a matching FT[A-Z]nnn value.

io800.name: External power
io800.description: AVL ID 800, External Voltage in mV. Traccar decodes this to `power` only when the device's model field matches FT[A-Z]nnn; with the model unset it arrives raw.

io70.name: PCB temperature
io70.description: AVL ID 70. The documented range of -550..1150 for a degrees-Celsius value means it is sent in tenths.

io255.name: Over speeding
io255.description: AVL ID 255, the speed at which an overspeed event triggered.

io254.name: Eco driving value
io254.description: AVL ID 254. The document gives the unit as 'G or rad' depending on configuration, so no device class is claimed.

io13370.description: AVL ID 13370, neighbouring cell 1 LAC. Changes on almost every report; enable it with a device override if you need it.
